meeting.summary: Finance Director presented the FY2025 tentative budget rollout. Highlights: 14 new positions (~$930K wages and benefits — 9 full-time, 2 part-time, 3 seasonal), a 3% market adjustment plus bringing all employees to 85% of pay-band midpoint (~$300K), $1.49M of one-time funding and equipment requests, OpenGov financial software cost trade-offs (~$100K/yr + $95K implementation), Mayor/Council compensation review, 2025 fireworks funding from reserves, and converting the long-range planner to full-time.
